Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music) — a core area of GCSE Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 1: Listening (Western and World Music).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
